Historical and genealogical research dossier

A historical life reconstructed source by source.

This public research project examines the life and hotel career associated with the names Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb and S. H. Gottlieb, while keeping evidence, uncertainty, and conflict visible.

Read the working biography Browse 26 sources
Identity noteOpen question

Matching initials, profession, and chronology strongly support identifying the Zürich hotelier S. H. Gottlieb with Baden-Baden hotelier Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb, but no direct linking record has yet made the identification conclusive.

Sources: SRC-001, SRC-002, SRC-003, SRC-004, SRC-008, SRC-009, SRC-011, SRC-020

Caution: Keep the Zürich initials record, the full-name Baden-Baden record, and the reported Vienna birth layer distinct until a municipal or other person-level source directly links the careers and birth information.

Documented anchors

What the evidence currently supports

The strongest findings are presented with their qualifications and source IDs intact.

CLAIM-BAUR-BIBLOS-OCR Verified direct

A 1914 contemporary travel guide describes S. H. Gottlieb as Direktor of the Savoy-Hotel Baur en Ville in Zürich.

Sources: SRC-004, SRC-019

Caution: This dated point does not prove continuous service from 1911 through 1922 or identify S. H. Gottlieb conclusively with the full-name Baden-Baden hotelier.

CLAIM-SAVOY-1922 Verified direct

A 1922 Swiss travel guide lists S. H. Gottlieb as director of Savoy-Baur en Ville in Zürich.

Sources: SRC-001

Conflicts with: CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GOTTLIEB-1910-1918, CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GIGER-1918-1926

Caution: This identifies S. H. Gottlieb, but does not by itself prove that he was Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb.

CLAIM-SYLVESTER-BADEN-HOTELIER-1931 Verified direct

A contemporary trade newspaper dated 20 March 1931 identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb in Baden-Baden as a hotelier.

Sources: SRC-020

Caution: This full-name Baden-Baden record strongly supports, but does not directly prove, identity with the Zürich hotel director known by initials.

CLAIM-MESSMER-LESSEE-1931 Verified direct

The 20 March 1931 entry describes Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as Pächter—lessee or operator—of Hotel Meßmer in Baden-Baden.

Sources: SRC-020

Caution: Pächter does not establish ownership of the hotel property.

Research priority

Trace the full-name hotelier.

Baden-Baden address books and the court file behind the 1931 bankruptcy notice may reveal residence, birth information, nationality, family status, and business arrangements—details needed to test the Zürich identity link.

Research leads: SRC-020, SRC-023
